decisions.reason: It matches the firm's agency and compliance focus and, after two years on a dedicated page, still looks like a viable adjacent option with limited carrying cost.
A web hosting management platform is strategically central to the firm's core offer and its home-page presence in both years signals continued commitment.
This configurable managed hosting plan is very close to the established business, can be supported with existing infrastructure, and remains a low-cost option worth keeping open.

Extended PHP security support fits the firm's security promise and agency customer base, but its newer launch and potentially higher support burden make it the most droppable of the four if uptake stays weak.
